Tom (customer): Hi all — SOC wants a bulletproof plan for air-gapped POC installs. need acceptance criteria, rollback, and options for <quarterly updates. also pricing for 40 appliances.
Lena (sales): Got it. We support three delivery patterns: one-time immutable image, scheduled quarterly full bundle, or monthly delta-chunks. Pricing differs — will run numbers. Any hard constraints on media type (usb vs encrypted drive)?
Tom (customer): Encrypted HDD only. no live network. custody chain required. updates <= quarterly preferred. emergency patching must be possible within 5 business days.
Priya (solutions): Notes: we produce a signed bundle tar + detached signature + CycloneDX SBOM + manifest.json with sha256 checks. For HDD we ship an encrypted LUKS container. Manifest contains: build_commit, quantization_profile, models_included, size_bytes.
Omar (eng): Installer behaviour: A/B slot with atomic switch. install writes to slot-B, runs verification suite (binary sig, sbom match, smoke tests), then flip. if smoke fails we revert automatically. rollback CLI: `redwoodctl offline rollback --to=previous`.
Carla (security): Requirement list from sec: signed SBOM, SLSA-like provenance file, detached GPG signature archived, signed release notes, proof of test run (smoke test logs), and a cert rotation plan that works offline (we hand over signed rotation tokens for you to apply). Also want HSM-backed archival of release manifests on your side.
Tom (customer): How big can the bundle be? devices have 600GB usable. models are pruned but we'd like few hundred billion param variants too.
Omar (eng): We can produce a trimmed model bundle ~160GB using 8-bit quant + weight pruning for single-model configs. For multi-model ensembles we can do layered bundles: core runtime (20GB) + optional model shards on separate media.
Priya (solutions): Delta strategy: we can do chunked deltas (rsync-friendly deltas) limited to ~10GB/month. Deltas come with their own signature and incremental manifest. Works with zero egress since media contains deltas only.
Lena (sales): Commercials: one-time delivery fee + per-node install fee for immutable image. Delta subscription has a monthly service fee + per-shipment fee. For 40 nodes and quarterly cadence we can propose a blended rate — I will post a draft in 72 hours.
Tom (customer): Rollback guarantees? need deterministic fallback within 10 minutes of failed healthcheck.
Omar (eng): With A/B layout we meet that. If install fails, agent triggers immediate rollback and sets node into read-only diagnostics mode. Logs: `/var/log/redwood/offline-install.log`. Healthcheck commands: `redwoodctl health --target local` returns JSON with status.
Carla (security): One more: telemetry policy — default is off. any telemetry requires operator opt-in and explicit export via removable media. We'll include an opt-in manifest in the bundle.
Priya (solutions): Acceptance checklist (draft): - Signed bundle + detached signature - CycloneDX SBOM - SHA256 manifest + build_commit - Install smoke tests pass (inference baseline within 2x cloud p95) - Backout verified (rollback test) - Custody chain + signed release notes - Offline cert-rotation token issued
Tom (customer): Good. POC timeframe? we need installable artifacts in 9 business days.
Omar (eng): Can deliver a non-prod signed sample bundle + verification doc in 7 business days. Will include commands: ```bash
# verify sig + manifest
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz
gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
redwoodctl verify --manifest manifest.json
redwoodctl install --bundle /media/bundle.tar.gz --slot B
```
Lena (sales): I'll coordinate shipping SLA options. For emergency hotfix SLA (<=5bd) we offer express courier + priority signing for an extra fee. Want me to include shipping partner details?
Tom (customer): yes, include partner + standard SLA and express option. chain-of-custody form required as PDF.
ShipBot: Created shipment placeholder: TRACKER-AG-20260515-01 (status: prepped). contains: encrypted-hdd, manifest, sbom, signed-notes.
Carla (security): I'll upload cert-rotation playbook (offline token format + apply steps) and SBOM attestation template in this thread tomorrow.
Priya (solutions): I'll attach a short operator playbook: verify -> mount -> smoke -> flip -> monitor. Also include a minimal UI snapshot (static html) for onsite operator checks.
Lena (sales): Next: I'll post pricing + SLA proposal in 72h. Omar will post sample bundle and verify steps in 7bd. Carla posts sec artifacts in 1bd. Priya posts playbook in 48h.
Tom (customer): thanks everyone. assign Lena for shipping contact follow-up. I'll DM shipping details. once we sign, we want a kickoff call and ship date. :thumbsup:
